blocks.text: A band that stuck through it all. For 24 years, Silent Sanctuary has been there for the kilig, the hugot, and every heartbreak in between. On October 25, the Mall of Asia Arena came alive as the band proved why they are indeed a cult-favorite as they dominated the stage with a setlist that took the audience back through life’s different chapters. Built over 24 years, the band’s catalog drew a crowd that spanned generations. Many of them knew every word, proof that these songs had long been been a part of their lives.
